rust_summary: scoreboard teams a server mod makes, colours, fills and empties (`native_team_set`, `native_team_join`, `native_team_leave`, `native_team_remove`).
doc_summary: `native_team_set(name, colour)` makes the team `name` when it is missing and sets its colour to one of the sixteen chat colours by RGB value (None: no colour); `native_team_join(name, holder)` puts `holder` in the team, out of the one it was in; `native_team_leave(holder)` takes it out of its team; `native_team_remove(name)` removes the team and its members' teams. Clients get the changes with the next tick's sync. Bundles need "hooks": @API:scoreboard_teams@.
